about: Tool servers the harness has read, each pinned to the exact version that was read. Package names and versions follow Munder Difflin's src/shared/mcpCatalog.ts (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Chaitanya Giri), checked there on 2026-10-14. {project} is replaced by the project's folder when a run starts the server. Godot, Blender and Unreal stay in prereq.known_servers (their own set-up steps).

servers.name: Files
servers.about: Reads, writes, edits and moves files in the project's folder.
servers.can: Change any file in the project's folder.

servers.name: Git
servers.about: Reads the project's history, and can stage, commit, branch and check out.
servers.can: Commit and change branches in the project's repository.

servers.name: SQLite database
servers.about: Runs SQL against the project's own SQLite file (app.db in its folder).
servers.can: Change and delete data in that database.

servers.name: Browser (Playwright)
servers.about: Drives a browser: opens pages, clicks, types and saves screenshots.
servers.can: Act as whoever is signed in on a site.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.about: Controls and inspects Chrome: pages, scripts, network and speed traces. Needs Chrome.
servers.can: Run scripts in the pages it opens.

servers.name: Fetch a page
servers.about: Reads a web address and gives back the page as text.
servers.can: Reach addresses on your home network too.

servers.name: Library documentation
servers.about: Looks up current documentation for libraries and frameworks (no key needed).

servers.name: Time
servers.about: The current time and conversions between time zones.

servers.name: Step-by-step thinking
servers.about: A scratchpad for reasoning one step at a time. It touches nothing else.
